## Change / 修改内容

<!-- What changed, why, and which issue or page does it address? Existing-page correction or new content? / 改了什么、为什么改、涉及哪个问题或页面？是修改已有内容还是新增？ -->

## Sources and reasoning / 来源与理由

<!-- Give authors, titles, versions, public URLs and precise locators. State the mathematical reason, including assumptions or a small counterexample. Distinguish inspected sources (actual dates) from leads. Chinese terminology needs its own usage evidence; an English definition alone is not enough. / 给出作者、版本、链接、具体位置和数学理由；核查日期如实填写。中文译名另附实际用法依据。 -->

## Attribution and rights / 署名与许可

<!-- Identify actual authors, editors and any AI-assisted drafting or translation. Do not list the site owner or a reviewer for work they did not do. State permissions for adapted material. / 写明实际作者、修改者和 AI 辅助；不要虚构站主署名或复核。改编内容请注明许可。 -->

New original encyclopedia and terminology text uses **CC BY-SA 4.0**. Existing personal notes, external works, quotations, images and other sections are not automatically relicensed. Confirm rights separately for new content outside those two sections.

新增原创百科与术语内容采用 **CC BY-SA 4.0**；不自动改变已有笔记、外部作品、引用、图片或其他栏目的许可。其他栏目的新内容请另行确认授权。

## Checklist / 检查清单

Check only items you actually checked; mark an item not applicable in the notes if needed. Unchecked items can be discussed during review. Automated checks do not certify mathematical correctness or external peer review.

只勾选实际检查过的项目；不适用的项目可在说明中写明。未完成的检查留待讨论，自动检查不能证明数学内容正确，也不代表外部同行评审。

- [ ] Definitions, conventions, theorem assumptions, proof steps and examples were checked. / 核对了定义、约定、条件、推导和例子。
- [ ] Sources have specific locators; mathematical and translation evidence are separate. / 来源位置具体，数学与译名依据分开。
- [ ] IDs, taxonomy, aliases and existing senses were checked; no duplicate or empty page was added. / 检查了标识、分类、别名和已有义项，没有重复或空页。
- [ ] New encyclopedia content follows the JSON-front-matter schema, seven required headings and corresponding terminology record. / 新百科符合 JSON 元数据和七个标题要求，并有对应术语记录。
- [ ] Existing published IDs, anchors, links and unrelated content are preserved. / 保留原有标识、锚点、链接及无关内容。
- [ ] English and Chinese remain aligned, or the translation needing review is explicitly identified. / 中英文对应，或明确标出待复核译文。
- [ ] Attribution, assistance, permissions and privacy are recorded accurately. / 署名、辅助工具、授权与隐私说明属实。
- [ ] Affected formulas, internal links, search, keyboard use and narrow-screen layout were tested. / 检查了相关公式、站内链接、搜索、键盘操作和窄屏显示。

## Checks run and remaining questions / 已运行检查与待确认问题

<!-- List actual commands/results and manual checks, not intended checks. For a small source-only proposal, say that build and generated-page review are left to the maintainer. / 列出实际运行的命令、结果及手动检查；只交源码时，可注明构建与生成页审核留给维护者。 -->

Maintainers run the dependency install, build and current workflow checks, then commit generated pages before merging or publishing. The read-only CI does not auto-merge or write to contributor branches. Submitting a PR requires a GitHub account, not a separate site account; publication follows review.

维护者运行依赖安装、构建及现行工作流检查，在合并或发布前提交生成页面。只读 CI 不会自动合并或写入投稿者分支。提交 PR 需要 GitHub 账户，不需本站账户，审核后才会发布。
